parameters.query: WITH authorized AS (SELECT 1 FROM workoutreach.operator_allowlist WHERE telegram_user_id = $1 AND telegram_chat_id = $2 AND enabled = true), inserted AS (INSERT INTO workoutreach.telegram_updates(update_id, telegram_user_id, telegram_chat_id, result_code) SELECT $3,$1,$2,'RECEIVED' FROM authorized ON CONFLICT (update_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING update_id) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM authorized) AS authorized, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS first_processing;
